tei:div.tei:p: (nya)༄༅// dus kyi 'khor lo la rgyun chags kyi sdeb sbyor gyi sgo nas bstod pa sogs dus 'khor gyi skor bzhugs so//

ham̐k+ṣamalawaraya / zhes gang grags pa yi byings dang sgra yis gang bsgrubs srid gsum sgyu ma'i rnam rol sna tshogs pa de swa bha wa ni dang por byas pa'i sngags don bsams pas rang rang ngo bos stong par sbyangs te 'gyur med ye shes lhun grub pa ni gcig pu kho na rdzas su lta ci sgra dang rtog pa'i yul min pas na ldog pa'i dbye ba du mar yang ni yod min pa de dbang dang byin rlabs ngo mtshar gdams pa'i stobs ldan byed pos lan brgyar g.yos pa las byung gzhan zhes bya ba'i rlung me sa chu ri mtsho gling gi phreng ba mtshar du dngar bas bkod legs mdzes par bskor ba'i dbus na gling brten mi phyed sems kyi rdo rje gang gi lhun po yi ni mgo bo'i rgya khyon dkyil na snying por gyur pa'i 'dab rgyas pad+ma'i lte ba la ni nyi ma zla ba dus kyi me dang sgra gcan zhes grangs lha mo'i pad+mar lhung ba'i tha mal nyi zla dbu mar zhugs pa'i ro gcig pa ni gzhan nyid kho nar gyur pa'i gdan gyi steng na dbu ma'i rang bzhin nam mkha'i mdog can gang nyid kyis ni gzung 'dzin lam gyi rgyu ba sbyangs pa'i zhabs gzung dag gis brjid par brdzis pas chags dang sdang ba'i zhi ba dang ni rtsub 'gyur dbyings su thim pa'i gzugs brnyan mtshan mar gyur pa gang yin de ni dpal mo'i dpal dang ri khrod ma dga' de yin ma dag gis ni snying ga'i nor 'dzin non par mnan pas me rlung 'khrugs pa'i g.yo 'gul gyis ni srid pa'i chu gter sdug bsngal rlabs 'phreng gyen du 'phyur bas srid pa'i rtse la bsnyab par mtshon nus de yang stong nyid ye shes rdo rje'i rta gdong 'bar bas nyin dang mtshan la bar mtshams med par skems par mdzad cing gnon par mdzad pa'i bcom ldan dpa' bo gang gi rlung bcu po ni dbu mar thim pa'i ya mtshan ltad mo sna tshogs ston mdzad nus ma rnam bcu'i blta dang sgeg dang gar dang 'khyud pa'i rnam rol gyis ni zag med bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba yis ni gang du gzung ba nam yang btang ba med pa'i zhal ni rlung me chu sa'i rang bzhin gzhan yin spyi bor 'khod pa'i bcu drug cha shas nam yang bri gang med des gyen du 'dren nus min pa'i yongs rdzogs rdul gyi cha shas dus mer gyur pa'i bcom ldan sgra gcan dbang po de ni gzhi lam 'bras bu'i dbu ma nyid do gzung 'dzin rlung gi g.yo ba med bzhin du yang rgyu yi rdor 'dzin bi shwa ma ltar zhugs pa'i rnam rol gyis ni dkon mchog rnam gsum dri za lta bur gyur pa pad+mar lhung ba'i khu rdul dag dang gcig tu 'dres pa rgyal ba byang sems khro bo'i tshogs rnams rang rang yum dang bcas pa'i skur 'khrungs pa ni dpa' bo nyid kyis sgyu ma'i bshad sgras gyen du drangs ste snying ga nas byung so so'i gdan la bkod nas bsnyen bsgrub yan lag kun rdzogs pa de mchod dang bstod dang bzlas bya'i sngags kyis gshin cing ljen la gnyen por gyur pa yis ni lam dus sgrub po rnal 'byor pa gang gis ni srid par skye ba'i rim pa kun sbyangs bdag tu rmongs pa ma lus pa sel de nas so sor bsdus pa rgyal ba'i dbang po rnam kun mchog ldan stong nyid yid 'ong skye mched ya mtshan gsal por 'dod pa'i sgeg 'chang ma de lang tsho sar pa'i snyems dang bcas pa'i dga' ba lhur blangs bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i dpa' bo gang dang tha dad min pa nyid gyur de tshe sad pa ces bya'i 'dra mtshungs lhur blangs tha mal snyoms 'jug gzhan du gyur pa'i ngo mtshar ltad mo srid dang zhi ba'i sems kyis dga' dang lus ngag gis ni bde ba kun la grags pa mang pos dpe bzlar bskrun pa min pa'i brjod bral zag med ye shes nyams myong sgyu ma'i bzhad sgra yis ni rnal 'byor pa rang nyid de yi ni ma 'ongs dus kyi dri za'i mi shes ring mo nyid nas drangs zhing bkug pa ye shes zhal sgor zhugs shing so sor thim pa'i rkyen gyis tha mal gnyis 'thug lta bus mtshan mo'i chos dbyings zhi ba'i lam du lan cig gzims pa dang ldan sgra don 'dres pa min pa'i shes pa gsal pos nyams su myong bya'i yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i skye mched gsal po dang 'grogs brgyad brgyas lhag pa'i stong phrag bdun pos zag bcas 'pho ba'i bde ba grangs de dang mnyam bcom zhing choms pas gzhung gzhan nas gsungs nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib 'ga' gnas gyur pa dang bsod nams tshogs chen rdzogs pas sa bdun dbang phyug nyid gyur dus der sngon dus bcom ldan nyid kyis thugs las 'phos pa'i tshad med bzhi po'i yid 'ong lha mor gyur gang gis ni rnal 'byor can khyod rdzogs sangs rgyas tshe gzhan don lhun grub rgyun mi chad cing chos dbyings zhi ba'i dbyings las bzhengs zhes lan gcig min par glu dbyangs snyan pos bskul ba las ni sad pa lta bur sgyu ma'i rnam rol gyis bzhengs lo gsum po dang phyogs gsum por ni rjes su dran dang ting 'dzin rnal 'byor gus dang rtag par sbyor ba'i bar mtshams yod min pa des tshe gcig nyid la rnal 'byor rang lus zab gsal thogs med 'ja' tshon lta bur bsgrub pa'i gegs kyi gtso bo ma lus 'joms byed mi 'gyur bde ba drug brgyas lhag pa'i stong phrag nyi shu rtsa gcig mngon gyur bcu gnyis dbang por rnams sangs rgyas tshe tha mal dus kyis phyir snang lta ci nang nyid du ni gang bshad de kun ma lus par yang rnams sangs rgyas phyir gnas skabs rigs bzhir 'char tshul mtha' dag gnas yongs gyur mod gang dang de dang 'drar mtshungs gyur pa'i gzugs brnyan ma lus 'char mdzad de yang dag pa'i snang ba 'ba' zhig pa yin rmi lam sgyu ma smig rgyu'i chu dang dri za'i grong khyer lta bu'i rten 'brel sna tshogs 'char zhing gzigs pas rnam 'gyur sna tshogs mnga' ba'i gar mkhan mchog de ma lus bdud las rgyal ba'i dus kyi 'khor lo nyid yin bdag dang gzhan du tha dad yod min pa yi phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod byed mchod bya mchod yul so sor min pa'i mchod pa mchog gis mchod do bsngo byed bsngo bya bsngo yul mang po pa dag so sor zhen pa btang nas sna tshogs spros pa'i yul du 'char yod min pa'i don dam ye shes rdo rje nga nyid bgrang yas rigs brgya'i bdag po dus kyi 'khor lo nyid gyur cig

dus kyi 'khor lor ma 'dus pa'i// dus gzhan yod min pa nyid la// dus gsum du ni phyag byas nas// dus nyid byed por khas blangs so// de ltar de sbyar las dge ba// gang skyes gang yin pa de yang ni// ma lus ma rnams dang lhan cig /'khor bar 'khor tshe bsod nams tshogs// rdzogs nas rdzogs sangs nyid gyur ces// sa 'dir sa skyong rgyal po ni// don yod don rnams kun grub pa'i// dgongs bzhed dgongs pa ji bzhin par// gyur gcig gyur nas rgyal po yi// mnga' ris mnga' 'bangs gang ba dang*// dbu rmog dbu 'phang gong nas gong*// je che je mthor gyur pa dang*// rtag tu rtag pa'i gnas thob shog /ces phyi nang gzhan gsum 'byor ba'i man ngag gi bstan bcos rin chen gter mdzod gsum pa zhes bya ba 'di ni/ sa skyong nyid kyi dgongs pa dang gsung zer nye bar sim pas sad byed kyi rkyen sbyar ste pho brang chen po rin chen spungs pa nyid du/ mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros nyid kyis legs par grub pa bgyis te/ yi ge pa ni bsod nams ye shes lhun grub bo// // ༄// rdo rje sems dpar phyag byas nas// gangs can ljongs 'dir phyis byon pa'i// chen po 'ga' zhig dus 'khor ba'i// thugs kyi dkyil 'khor zur phyung nas// bri dang bsgrub dang dbang dang ni// mngon par rtogs pa de bsgoms pas// dus 'khor gyi dgag bzhag spang gsum rnam par bzhag pa rin chen sna bdun/ bskyed pa'i rim pa mthar phyin nas// rdzogs pa'i rim la 'jug ces zer// de tsam gyis ni rnal 'byor pa'i// nang gi bskyed rim mthar phyin mod// 'bum phrag bzhi pa'i 'jig rten khams// bcud dang bcas pa'am bag chags kyi// sbyong byed rim pa ma bstan phyir// zhing sbyong nus pa ma yin no// bag chags thams cad rang sems las// logs su yod pa min phyir// sems nyid gcig pu de sbyangs pas// zhing kun mthong bar nus zhe na// gzhan gyur dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs pa'i// zag med sa bon kun gzhi yi// ye shes nyid la ma bzhag na// rdzogs sangs rgyas tshe dkyil 'khor kun// yongs su rdzogs par 'char mi nus// de 'char ba ni lam dus su// yongs rdzogs goms par byas la rag

/dper na 'khor ba thog med du// goms pa'i bag chags ji snyed pa// nam zhig smin par gyur pa'i tshe// thams cad gsal bar snang de bzhin// sngon dus bya byed las gsum gyis// bzhag pa'i bag chags da ltar ba// yongs rdzogs bskyed pa'i rim pas sbyongs// ci phyir zhe na bag chags de// rnam par smin pa ma 'ongs pa// 'byin par nus pa yod min par// bskyed pa'i rim pas byas phyir ro// rnam smin dngos su grub zin pas// zag med bde ba chen po dang*// phrad pas med par byed nus de// sems rgyud zag med du byas phyir// rang gi sems nyid ma lus pa// zag med nyid du byas phyir ro// 'khor ba'i gnyen por de dang ni// rnam pa 'gal ba dgos min nam// zhe na nyon mongs pa dang ni// rjes mthun gzhan zhes bya ba zhig /goms pas de spong byed pa ni// chags chen gyis ni chags pa bzhin// nang las ma rtogs don gzhan ni// yod pa min zhes zer ba'i lan// 'o na bdag med rtogs pa yi// shes rab gcig pus chog par 'gyur// spangs bya'i sa bon kun 'joms pas// de nyid gcig pus chog mod kyang*// 'tshang rgya ba la bsod nams tshogs// grangs med dgos pa yin zhe na// rang gi phung khams sogs sbyong ba// thugs kyi 'khor los chog mod kyang*// bsod nams tshogs chen rdzogs pa la// yongs rdzogs 'khor lo bsgom par bya// zhes bya ba 'di yang sgrub pa'o// // ༄༅// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ dus kyi 'khor lor phyag byas nas// gang der bshad pa'i bskyed pa dang*// rdzogs pa'i rim pa zung 'brel gyi// rnam gzhag gsal po bshad par bya// byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun po// mtshan nyid rdzogs pas smin gyur na// nang pa'i sngags su smos ci dgos// phyi pa'i sngags par yang smin byed// skabs 'di'i phyi nang khyad par ni// 'gyur med lhan skyes bde chen po// bdag du 'dogs dang bdag med du// legs par bshad pa'i khyad par ro// bskyed rim zhes pa sbyang gzhi dang*// sbyong byed legs par ngo 'phrod pa'i// dkyil 'khor 'khor lo yongs rdzogs pa// blo la gsal bar snang de yin// gsal snang de la rtog pa dang*// rtog med shes la gsal snang ba// rab kyi mthar phyin gnyis su ni// dbye ba shing rta'i srol las byung*// bskyed pa'i rim la gnyis phye ba// kun gyis bsod nams tshogs rdzogs byed// tshogs de mchog gi dngos grub kyi// rgyur ni med mi rung yin mod// rtog par gyur pa'i bskyed rim tsam// kho na de yi rgyur mi bzhed// de phyir thun mong dngos grub tsam// 'dod la dbang bdun bskur bar gsungs// de lta na yang dbang bdun po// med par bskyed rim mi 'byung zhing*// bskyed rim gsal ba mthar phyin pa// med par bsod nams tshogs mi rdzogs// dkyil 'khor 'khor lo yongs rdzogs pa// gsal bar snang la'ang rnam gnyis te// byis pa'i dbang gis rgyud smin nas// yongs rdzogs gsal bar snang ba dang*// de med par yang so so bsdud// goms pa rab kyi mthar phyin tshe// lha yi 'khor lo yongs rdzogs pa// stong nyid gzugs su shar ba'o// snga ma byis 'jug dbang bdun po// sngon du song ba'i rim pa las// byung ba dus kyi 'khor lo 'dir// bskyed pa'i rim pa mtshan nyid pa// yin no phyi ma dbang bzhi pa'i// myong bya rdzogs rim kho nar nges// 'di 'dra byis 'jug dbang bdun po// med par yang skye srid mod kyi// rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i bzlas phye ba'i// bskyed pa'i rim par 'chad mi nus// de lta na yang byis 'jug gi

/dbang gis smin pa'i bskyed rim dang*// bde chen dang ni stong pa nyid// gsum gyi gzhi mthun 'gal med pa// 'jig rten 'das pa'i dbang bzhi pos// smin pa mthar phyin tshe na 'byung*// byis 'jug dbang bdun ma bskur bar// sa bdun dbang phyug mi 'byung zhing*// de 'byung ba la'ang 'jig rten las// 'das pa'i dbang bzhi med mi rung*// yin no ci yi phyir zhe na// 'gyur med bde ba stong brgyad brgya// mngon du gyur pa de med na// sa dang po yang 'thob mi srid// de mngon 'gyur ba dbang bzhi pas// smin la rag las yin phyir ro// bod du rnal 'byor yan lag drug /'chad po rnams la srol gnyis byung*// dbang bdun las thob bskyed pa'i rim// sngon 'gro dgos dang mi dgos pa// snga ma gsang sngags spyi skad dang*// mthun no phyi ma dus 'khor lo'i// rgyud dang 'grel pa'i dngos bstan las// gsal bar byung ba de yin no// phyi rabs 'di na gsang sngags pa// spyi dang mthun pa de khyad 'phags// phyi ma grangs can la sogs pa'i// gzhung na'ang yod pa de yin zer// skabs 'dir re shig brtag bya ba// 'di la lan 'debs yod na smros// rgyud 'grel dngos bstan bsnyon mi nus// kho nar ma zad bla med kyi// dbang bskur phal cher thog ma ni// bum pa'i dbang nas bzung min nam// 'dir yang bum pa'i dbang sogs kyi// bsgom bya ma tshang med pa ni// rnal 'byor yan lag drug ka'am// gnyis tsam la'ang tshang bar bzhugs// yan lag drug po'i nang tshan du// bskyed rim gsal bar bstan pa med// tshe 'dir sangs rgyas 'grub pa la// rnal 'byor yan lag drug las gzhan// kha skong gzhan nas tshol dgos pa'i// bshad pa rgyud 'grel las mi 'byung*// ci phyir zhe na sangs rgyas dang*// sems can dag gi khyad par ni// 'pho ba'i bag chags spangs ma spangs// nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'i rlung*// 'gags dang ma 'gags pa dag la// bshad nas de spong gnyen po ni// 'gyur med bde stong zung 'jug las// gzhan zhig dgos pa'i bshad pa med// bde stong zung du 'jug pa nyid// bskyed pa'i rim pa yin zhe na// dbang bskur bzhi pa'i bsgom bya nyid// bskyed pa'i rim par bshad pa med// spyir yang bskyed rdzogs zung 'grel zhes// 'chad kyi zung 'jug tu mi 'chad// bde dang stong pa zung 'jug tu// 'chad kyi zung 'brel du mi 'chad// de ltar 'chad pa rgyud 'grel gyi// dngos bstan yin no lugs gzhan gyi// chos skad rgyud 'dir bsres gyur na// gzhan dang thun mong min pa ci// zer ba'i lan ni phyi rabs kyi// mkhas rlom kun kyis 'debs 'tshal lo// 'dri po nyid la'ang slar 'dri na// gzhung gzhan zhig tu gsal la ltos// de skad 'di yang sa skyong la// dogs pa'i gnas gzhan mang po zhig

/'khrungs zhes gsungs pa'i mchid lan du// mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros kyis// rin chen spungs pa'i nang du sbyar// // ༄༅// swa sti/ dus kyi 'khor lor phyag byas nas// rgyud dang 'grel pa'i sgras zin la// mchog gi dngos grub don gnyer ba'i// blo bzang 'ga' yis 'di bsam bya// thog ma nyid du 'jig rten las// 'das pa'i dbang bzhis smin pa dang*// yan lag drug gis grol ba 'ga'// slar yang thun mong gi dngos grub// 'dod pas byis 'jug dbang bdun po// blangs nas rgyud 'grel nyan pa dang*// bskyed pa'i rim gyi nyams len la// zhugs tshe bdag dang bla ma dang*// rgyud la yid ches rnam gsum 'byung*// de phyir rdzogs pa'i rim pa la// bskyed rim sngon 'gro'i nges pa med// ces gsungs pa dang 'pho ba yi// bag chags kho na zad byed kyi// gnyen pos rdzogs sangs rgya nus zhes// rgol ba'i lan zhig brtag bya ba// yon tan ma lus kun rdzogs zhing*// sgrib kun bral ba'i sangs rgyas rgyur// bsod nams tshogs dang ye shes kyi// tshogs gnyis zung 'brel med mi rung*// sngags kyi bsod nams tshogs sog pa// bskyed rim 'khor bcas las gzhan med// ye shes tshogs can 'ga' zhig gis// sgrib kun drungs nas 'byin nus mod// bsod nams tshogs dang ma spel na// chad pa'i dbyings su 'gyur ba dang*// chos kyi sku las ma g.yos par// gzhan snang gzugs sku'i rnam rol ni// sna tshogs ston par nus min te// phar phyin theg par yang dag mtha'// dus min mngon du byas pa la// nyes pa'i rnam grangs mang po dang*// sa brgyad par yang 'gog pa las// slong dgos yon tan bshad ji bzhin// ye shes tshogs kyi spang bya ni// 'pho ba'i bag chags kyang yin mod// bdag dang gang zag tu 'dzin pa'i// rmongs chen gnyen po ma bsams na// mu stegs gzhung dang sangs rgyas kyi// gzhung lugs khyad par dbye mi nus// ci phyir zhe na 'pho ba yi// bag chags drungs nas 'byin byed kyi// gnyen po 'gyur med bde ba ni// mu stegs byed la'ang srid phyir ro// 'o na rnam pa thams cad kyi// mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid// mngon sum mthong ba'i mu stegs kyang*// yod par ha cang thal zhe na// rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i// stong pa nyid kyi ngos 'dzin ni// chos su ma zad gang zag gi

/dbang du byas pa'i bzung ba dang*// 'dzin pa gnyis kas stong pa yi// ye shes de la ngo sprod byed// de la der ngo ma 'phrod na// bdag tu rmongs pa'i zhags pas 'ching*// mi 'gyur bde bas 'pho ba yi// bag chags re shig sun phyung kyang*// de la bdag tu sgro btags pas// spangs pa ma lus slar ldog 'gyur// de phyir bskyed pa'i rim pa ni// gsal ba rab kyi mthar phyin tshad// 'khor ba'i rtsa ba gang zag gi /bdag tu rmongs pa drung 'byin byed// de nas rdzogs pa'i rim pa yi// gtso bo bde stong zung 'jug pas// chos kyi bdag 'dzin ma lus pa// drungs 'byin nus pa kho nar ni// ma zad 'pho ba'i bag chags kyis// tshe 'di nyid la dus 'khor lo'i// go 'phang mngon du byed pa yi// gegs gyur bem po gdos bcas kyi// lus de 'ja' tshon lta bu yi// lus su byed pa'i thabs kyi mchog /'gyur med bde ba chen po zhes// bya ba 'jig tshogs lta ba dang*// bral ba'i ye shes nyid gyur tshe// bde stong zung du 'jug yin gyi// chos 'ga' gzhan gyi ngo bo yis// stong pa tsam gyis der mi 'jog /bskyed rim dus su bsod nams dang*// bdag med rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi// tshogs sog zung du 'brel byas pas// sa bdun dbang phyug nyid du 'gyur// de nas bde stong zung 'jug gi /ye shes tshogs sog 'ba' zhig pas// bcom ldan dus kyi 'khor lo yi// go 'phang tshe 'dir mngon du byed// ces pa rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi rgyur// bskyed rdzogs zung 'brel dgos pa la// gzhan gyis brtsad pa'i lan yin te// dri ma med kyi dngos bstan dang*// 'gal ba'i dogs pa 'khrungs gyur na// mkhas dang chos skyong bsrung ma'i tshogs// ma lus bzod par mdzad du gsol// shubhaṃ// // ༄༅// dus kyi 'khor lor phyag byas nas// 'di na la la sor sdud dang*// srog rtsol yan lag mthar phyin nas// las rlung nyi khri chig stong dang*// drug brgya 'gags pa'i dus de nyid// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dngos yin te// las rlung stong dang brgyad brgya pa// tshan pa re re 'gags pa dang*// sa ni bcu gnyis po re re// thob pa dus mnyam du bshad pas// zer te sor bsdud bsam gtan gyis// bdag tu 'dzin pa gnyis po yi// sa bon drungs nas 'byin byed pa'i// gnyen po mngon sum byas gyur na// de ltar yin mod de med na// rlung 'gags pa tsam rdul mtha' dang*// bum can 'byongs la'ang yod pa'i phyir// so so skye bo las dang po// 'ga' dang mu stegs can 'ga' la'ang*// de ltar thal ba bzlog du med// de phyir rnal 'byor yan lag drug

/bskyed rim mtshan nyid tshang gang rung*// zhig la sbyangs pa sngon song na// mchog rab yin mod de med na// yan lag drug po so so yi// skabs su bdag med ngo sprod dang*// sbyang gzhi sbyong bar nus pa yi// bskyed rim gang rung re re dang*// spel nas goms pas bsod nams dang*// ye shes tshogs dag rdzogs nus kyi// rlung 'gags pa tsam bum pa can// 'byongs dang phyag rgya rnam pa gsum// mthar phyin tsam la sangs rgyas sar// 'jog par nus pa ma yin no// la la lung gi dngos bstan las// byung ba'i bcu gnyis dbang phyug te// sa dang po tsam yin zhes zer// gang zag gi ni bdag med pa// mngon sum rtogs pa yod med las// de yang de lta yin ma yin// gsal bar phye nas rtogs par bya// de skad 'di ni dus 'khor lo'i// bskyed rdzogs rnam gzhag dad pa yi// rjes 'brang tsam du ma bzhag par// chos kyi rjes 'brang bya phyir bsngo// shubhaṃ// // ༄༅// swa sti// dus kyi 'khor lor phyag byas nas// rnal 'byor yan lag drug goms pa'i// dus la lo gsum phyogs gsum zhes// bshad pa'i don gang yin pa bsam// lo gsum phyogs gsum zhes bya ba// tshes zla gsum cu so bdun po// phyed dang bcas pa'i ming yin la// skyes bu tshe lo brgya pa yi// dus la zla shol dor ba'i grangs// de tsam 'dor dgos ci zhe na// rab byung la sogs lo brgya la// khyim zhag re re nas bgrangs pa'i// zla ba stong dang nyis brgya dgos// tshes zhag re re nas bgrangs pa'i// zla ba stong dang nyis brgya bos// snga ma'i tshad der ma longs pas// shol zla de tsam bton pa na// snga ma'i tshad de long phyir yin// khyim gyi zla dang tshes kyi zla// tshad mi mnyam pa ci zhe na// khyim zhag gcig po tshang dgos pa'i// 'pho chen bcu gnyis re re la// las rlung stong dang brgyad brgya yi// yun tshad longs pa dgos rgyu la// 'pho chen mtshams su las kyi rlung*// khug pa nga drug rkang bcas re// chad nas rgyu ba med song phyir// khyim gyi zhag dang zla ba dang*// lo'i tshad du longs pa la// tshes zhag re re stengs su yang*// dbugs kyi khug pa drug brgya dang*// bdun cu rtsa lnga zhag re bzhin// lhag por bsnan pa bsags pa'i tshe// bsags pa bsdoms pas lo gsum dang*// phyogs gsum gyi ni zla grangs byung*// grangs de 'chi ba bslu byed kyi// zla grangs yin te de tsam zhig

/chad pa 'chi byed grangs yin phyir// yan lag drug goms rnal 'byor pas// bum pa can dang rdul mtha' can// sgrubs pa'i 'og tu lo gsum dang*// phyogs gsum por ni gzung 'dzin gyi// rgyu ba slar yang bsgrub bya ste// gzhan du rnal 'byor pa de yis// gzung 'dzin rgyu ba bkag pa'i phyir// dus min 'chi bar dogs phyir ro// dbu mar zhugs pa'i rlung dang sems// slar yang gzung 'dzin lam dag tu// slar ldog dgos na glang chen gyis// khrus dang 'dra ba ma yin nam// zhe na dgos pa so so'i phyir// 'dzin pa grub pa'i 'og rol du// phyag rgya gsum pa goms bya'i phyir// dbu mar zhugs pa'i byang chub sems// 'bems dang bzlog dang khyab byed pa// gzung 'dzin lam du zhugs pa yi// rgyu ba med na mi 'byung phyir// lo gsum po dang phyogs gsum por// 'jig rten pa yi tshe sgrub byed// de ltar byas pas mi 'gyur ba'i// bde ba nyi khri chig stong po// khyim zhag cig la tshang ba ni// ting 'dzin rnal 'byor gyis grub pa// bcu gnyis sa yi dbang phyug go /zhes 'di gzhan gyis ma bshad pa// bshad pa'i dge bas bdag dang yang*// slob mar bcas rnams mchog tu ni// 'gyur med bde ba'i gnas thob shog /dge'o// // ༄༅// swa sti/ dus kyi 'khor lor phyag byas nas// 'di na la la las kyi rlung*// dbu ma'i lam du ma thim par// bum pa can sgom don med de// sbud pa rlung gis khengs pa bzhin// lam du mi 'gyur ma zad kyi// rtsa log 'ga' la rlung zhugs nas// gol sa mang po bskyed ces zer// man ngag gzhung la ma brten na// gol sa bskyed pa mang dag srid// de la brten pa'i bum pa can// rnam pa gnyis te gzung 'dzin gyi// lam du rlung sdom byed pa dang*// dbu ma'i lam du de bsdom pa'o// snga mas las nyon gyis 'phangs pa'i// rnam smin lus kyi tshe sring byed// phyi ma mchog gi dngos grub rgyu// yin mod gnas skabs 'ga' zhig tu// las kyi rlung dang ma spel na// rnam smin tshe la gnod pa srid// de yi shes byed las kyi rlung*// 'pho chen bcu gnyis re re po'i// mtshams su nga drug rkang bcas re// gzung 'dzin lam las gol ba na// zhag re re la rtsa gnyis gnyis// chad par gsungs pa yin phyir ro// rnal 'byor pa yis zhag re la// las rlung nyi khri chig stong las// ches cher lhag pa gzung 'dzin gyi// lam du sdoms pa'i yon tan gyis// skyes bu tshe lo brgya pa yang*// rnam smin tshe grangs 'phel nus te// rnal 'byor med pa sor bzhag na// khyim lo go bdun mthar son tshe// tshe zad 'gyur ro ci phyir na// dbu mar song ba'i lo gsum dang*// phyogs gsum skabs der tshang phyir ro// 'o na dbu ma'i lam du ni// gnas pa lam byed don med du// 'gyur ro zhe na ma yin te// zag bcas tshor bas ma reg pa'i// zag med bde ba chen po ni// dbu mar gnas pa lam byed pa'i// bum pa can 'byongs mthar phyin pa// med na mi 'byung yin phyir ro// rnal 'byor slob pa'i lam skabs su// bum pa can 'byongs 'og tu yang*// gzung dang 'dzin pa'i lam dag tu// srog ni nges par 'jug dgos te// de med par ni sgo gsum gyi// bya ba kun nas slong mi nus// rnam smin tshe lo brgya lon pa'i// rnal 'byor pas kyang lo gsum dang*// phyogs gsum dag tu tshe bsring ba// nges par dgos pa srid phyir dang*// gzung 'dzin lam du gang rgyu ba// thams cad las kyi rlung kho nar// nges pa min te gang gi phyir// bdag med rtogs pa'i thos bsam gyi// rtog pa kun nas slong byed bzhin// de skad 'dir yang rnal 'byor par// khas len byed la dris pa na// ci zer gtol med 'gyur mthong nas// legs pa'i blo yis smras pa'o// maṅga laṃ/// /

༄༅// swa sti/ dus kyi 'khor lor phyag byas nas// nang du las kyi rlung rgyu ba// dbu mar song ba'i byed pa yis// zhag mi thub 'byung tshul bshad pa// skabs 'dir nyin zhag zhes bya ba'i// rnam gzhag logs su bshad mi dgos// khyim zhag re la nyin zhag las// cung zad lhag pa re dgos te// khyim zhag gsum brgya drug cur ni// ma tshang ba la lo mi tshang*// de tshang ba la nyin zhag ni// gsum brgya drug bcu re lnga po// nges par tshang bar dgos phyir ro// de tshang ba la las kyi rlung*// 'pho chen re re'i tshe longs pa// 'byung 'jug gnas gsum tshad ldan pa// stong dang brgyad brgya re rer ni// nges par tsha ba dgos rgyu la// 'byung ba che chung 'pho mtshams su// cung zad tsam re ma tshang ba// bsags pas 'pho chen mtshams dag tu// nga drug rkang bcas re ma tshang*// de bsags pa las tshes kyi zla// sum cu so gnyis phyed bcas na// khyim gyi zla ba'ang de tsam du// tshes zla gcig gis tshang ma nus// de yi tshe na tshes zla gcig /lhag por bzhag pas de grangs tshang*// de phyir las kyi rlung rgyu ba// chad pa'i yon tan bsags pa las// zla ba'i 'phel 'grib sum cu po// lhag chad med par tshang ba dang*// de tshang ba la nyin zhag ni// sum cur cung ma tshang bas chog /zla shol bton pa'i yon tan gyis// nyi mas khyim chen bcu gnyis po// lhag chad med par 'khor ba dang*// dus bzhi rdzogs par tshang ba 'byung*// gzung ba'i lam du las kyi rlung*// dgos pa'i tshad las ches lhag par// 'dzin nus gyur na nyi mas kyang*// rang khyim 'khor la yun ring thogs// 'dzin pa'i lam du las kyi rlung*// rgyu ba'i tshad las lhag bsdams na// zla ba'i cha shas 'phel 'grib la// ring du thogs te rnal 'byor pa// rang rang so so'i ngor yin no// gzung 'dzin lam du rgyu ba yi// srog dang khu rdul ji snyed kyis// zag bcas lus 'dzin bskyed byed kyi// dbu mar zhugs pa'i de rnams kyis// de zad byed cing zag med kyi// de dag bskyed cing 'dzin par byed// srog dang khu rdul sngags kyi sems// dbu mar ma zhugs pa rnams kyi// rjes dran rnal 'byor 'khor ba yi// rgyu yin 'dzin 'grem nus tsam gyis// thar pa'i lam du 'khrul mi bya// de ltar bshad pas 'khor ba dang*// mya ngan 'das pa mtha' dag kyang*// nang gi dbang las byung ba ste// tha mal rlung sems 'khor ba dang*// rnal 'byor rlung sems mya ngan las// 'das pa kun gyi rgyur shes bya// rnal 'byor yan lag drug po yang*// smon 'jug sems kyis ma zin pa// dman pa'i mya ngan 'das pa dang*// bdag du rmongs pa ma bzlog na// srid pa'i rtse mo'i rgyur yang ni// srid pa legs par shes byas nas// rang rang skabs kyi ngo sprod dang*// gol sa ma lus shes par bya// 'di yang sngags kyi sgom chen pa// phyi rol don la zhen ches nas// 'khrul snang chos su smra rnams kyis// nyes par bshad pa bsal phyir ro// shu bhaṃ//

// ༄༅// dus kyi 'khor lor zhes bya ba// dus ni las rlung 'byung 'jug nas// de yod pa dang de bzlog las// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das ches gsal// 'byung 'jug gnas gsum tshang gyur pa// gcig gi bya rdzogs skad cig ma// gzung 'dzin lam du zhugs gyur pa// re res 'khor ba'i bya ba gcig /rdzogs shing bzlog pas myang 'das kyi// cha shas gdod nas grub pa re// gsal por byed cing mi 'gyur ba'i// bde ba bya rdzogs skad cig ma// gcig kyang rlung gcig 'gags pas 'grub// de ltar shes pa mdor bstan pas// dus kyi 'khor lo'i rnal 'byor la// gangs can ljongs su phyis byon pa// mang pos brtsad pa spang bar nus// de la kha cig 'di skad du// shing rta'i srol chen las byung ba'i// rigs pas gtan la ma phab par// stong nyid mthong ba log pa'i blo// gang du snang ba de gzhan gyis// stong la stong pa nyid 'jog na// don snang shes pa rtog med kyang*// rnam kun mchog ldan stong nyid du// thal bar 'gyur te don snang shes// don gyis stong pa nyid phyir ro// rigs pas gtan la ma phebs pa'i// rten 'brel sna tshogs su snang ba// don dam bden na tha mal gyi// shes kun don dam rtogs blor 'gyur// zer te 'di lan bsam bya ba// gzung dang 'dzin pa glo bur gyi// dri ma dang ni 'khor ba ste// gnyis med ye shes gdod ma nas// rang bzhin mya ngan 'das par grub// shing rta'i srol dang sngags gzhung kun// gzung 'dzin rtog las ma grol ba// de srid don dam mi mthong zhing*// de grol ba las de mthong bar// mthun no shing rta'i srol gcig las// kun rdzob thams cad rang stong du// grub pas gzung 'dzin gnyis bral ba'i// ye shes dam pa'i don nyid du// grub dang shing rta'i srol gcig las// chos kun rang stong nyid grub pas// rnam rtog 'dzin pa kun log pa// rnam par dpyad pa'i 'bras bur bzhed// sngags su rtog pa kun 'gog pa'i// thabs ni man ngag nyid las te// rlung 'gog pa dang lus kyi ni// byed pa bcings pa la sogs so// 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa ni// rig pa'am yang na man ngag chos// gang las yin kyang khegs gyur na// mya ngan 'das pa lhun gyis grub// rigs pa med par rnam rtog de// khegs pa'i tshad ma med snyam na// las kyi rlung las ma byung ba'i// rnam par rtog pa srid ma yin// las rlung ji snyed nyi khri dang*// chig stong dag tu ma 'dus med// de kun 'pho chen bcu gnyis kyi// lam las gzhan du 'gro med phyir// 'pho chen bcu gnyis 'gags pa na// rnam par rtog pa ma lus khegs// rnam rtog ces pa zhen pa'i blo// 'ba' zhig tsam du ma zad kyi// ma rig dbang gis khams gsum par// snang ba'i yang dag min rtog go

/so sor bsdud pas tha mal gyi// dbang po yul la 'jug khegs pa// de tshe mig rna sogs gzhan la// khams gsum snang ba gang shar yang*// yang dag ma yin kun rtog pa// min pa'i shes byed tha mal gyi// mig sogs dag la snang min gyi// mig gzhan zhes pa tha mal gyi// bdag rkyen mig gi dbang po dang*// dmigs rkyen gzugs la ma brten par// gzugs sogs gsal ba'i mngon sum mo// de 'dra sgra don 'dres 'dzin dang*// yang dag min rtog ma yin pa// de tshe rtog pa kun bral ba'i// gdod ma'i shes par lhun gyis grub// gsal snang 'di yang las kyi rlung*// 'gags pa nyid las skye 'gyur gyi// de ma 'gags par mi 'byung ba// de phyir ting nge 'dzin las byung*// de yang rtog pa dang bral zhing*// 'phral gyi 'khrul rgyu gang gis kyang*// 'khrul par bskyed pa med pa'i phyir// gnas lugs mthong ba'i mngon sum mo// 'o na rnal 'byor gyi mngon sum// nyid du thal bar 'gyur zhe na// gsang sngags pa rnams stong pa nyid// mngon sum mthong la dpe dang*// don gyi ye shes gnyis su 'byed// mngon sum mtshan nyid tshang 'dra yang*// 'gyur ldog byed dang mi byed pa// mthong bas spang bya las grol dang*// ma grol ba las phye ba yin// des na 'di la dbang po yi// mngon sum zhes ni mtshan gsol to// rlung 'gags pa las gzung 'dzin gyi// rtog pa re shig tsam khegs kyang*// sa bon 'joms pa'i nus pa ni// de la yod pa min zhe na// de 'dra gcig dang du bral sogs// rigs shes rjes dpag la yang mtshungs// rigs rgyun goms pas de sun 'byin// snyam na dbu mar mtshungs pa'i rlung*// ring du goms pas de sun 'byin// de lta na yang sngags lugs la// rigs pa don med ma yin te// mnyam gzhag dus su mthong ba'i don// rjes la bdag tu sgro 'dogs pa// thos dang bral la srid pa'i tshe// rigs pa don yod nyid phyir ro// de ltar bshad pa las byung rnam dkar des ni bdag dang skal mnyam gzhan yang gzung 'dzin gyi// lam du rigs par rgyu ba'i 'gros chen rnam gnyis thog mar khegs pas 'gyur med bde 'grub cing*// 'gyur med bde las ma nyams par yang gzung 'dzin lam dag stongs pa min pa'i rnal 'byor gyi// chig stong drug brgyas lhag pa'i mchog tu mi 'gyur bde ba'i grangs kyis sa chen bcu gnyis po// tshe gcig nyid la mngon du byed pa'i gegs gyur dus min 'chi ba kun las de grol shog

/'gyur ba'i bde la 'dir bsngags pa// tshe gcig nyid la dus 'khor lo'i// go 'phang thob la gegs byed pa// 'pho ba'i bag chags spong phyir te// chos dang gang zag tu rmongs pa'i// gnyan po bdag med rnam pa gnyis// 'di bsngags pa las nyon mongs dang*// shes bya'i sgrib pa las grol shog /ces dus kyi 'khor lo'i rnal 'byor gyi rnam gzhag la/ dgag bzhag spang gsum gyi tshul rnam par bshad pa rin chen sna bdun zhes bya ba 'di ni/ phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i sa skyong don yod rdo rje rgyal po'i bkas gnang gi rnam dpyod kyi spobs pa rigs par sad pa'i de ma thag rkyen bgyis te/ dpal shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros kyis/ chos dang srid kyi dpal 'byor mang pos mngon par mtho ba'i pho brang chen po/ rin chen spungs pa'i gzhal med khang chen po'i yang thog gi rtse mo nyid du legs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni/ rkong ston chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'o// //shu bhaṃ// // ༄༅// phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi rnam bzhag/ swa sti/ rdzogs sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal nas// de nas phar phyin theg par yang*// phyi nang gzhan zhes bya ba yi// rnam gzhag 'chad tshul de bsam bya// phyi yi dbang gis nang 'byung zhing*// nang ni rnam shes 'khor bcas pa// kho nar 'dod de nyan thos pa'i// lugs yin theg chen gzhung na med// nang gi dbang gis phyi 'byung zhing*// nang la rnam shes ye shes dang*// phyi la chos dang gang zag tu// 'byed par theg chen pa kun mthun// kun tu btags pa phyi yin te// gzhan gyi dbang ni nang nyid dang*// gdod nas yongs su grub pa ni// gnyis med gzhan zhes bya bar 'chad// gzhan gyi dbang las gang 'byung ba'i// chos dang gang zag rnams kun btags// gnyis snang 'khrul pa'i bag chags kyis// khams gsum par snang de gzhan dbang*// de las chos dang gang zag zhes// btags pa'i yod pa de dngos med// rnam shes dngos po de bden zhes// sems tsam pa'i 'dod pa ste// gnyis med ye shes de bden pa// chos 'khor gsum pa'i dbu mar 'dod// 'dir ni phyi nang gzhan ji snyed// chos kyi dbyings las byung ba ste// phyi dang nang ni glo bur du// 'bral rung tshul du byung ba ste// rnam byang chos ni gsar byung yang*// chos kyi dbyings dang dbye ba med// chos dbyings ngo shes byed tshul la// gzhung dang man ngag lugs gnyis byung*// dang po gzung 'dzin gnyis med du// thos bsam sgom pa las yin te// phyi ma sems kyi ngo bo la// blta tshul 'khrul pa med las rnyed// dang po nyid nas rtog med du// skye ba man ngag lugs yin te// sor bsam sgom byung las dang po// thog mar rtog pa nyid du skye// chos kyi dbyings la nyon mongs dang*// rnam rtog bag chags bzhag pa las// gnas pa kun gzhi sa bon che// smin pa kun gzhi'i rnam shes dngos// ma 'ongs dus su smin 'gyur ba'i// sa bon da lta ba nyid dang*// sngon dus bag chags 'dir smin pa// de dag la 'dir de skad brjod// gdod ma'i ye shes gcig nyid la// gnyen po rnam byang ye shes dang*// spang bya bag chags rnam smin gsum// gnas la khyad par med dus su'ang*// goms byed blo yi phyogs 'dzin pas// gnyen pos spang bya spong bar nus// spang bya'i bag chags da ltar bas// rnam smin la sogs ma 'ongs pa// skye ba'i nus pa 'joms byed kyi// skyes zin 'das dang da ltar ba// gnyen pos spong tshul phar phyin gyi// theg par bshad pa yod ma yin// sngags su snod bcud grub zin pa'i// kun rdzob ngo bo stong nyid du// sbyangs nas don dam ye shes kyi// ngo bo lha ru grub pa na// rnam smin grub zin da ltar ba// spangs pa'i thabs mkhas bshad pa yin// zhes bya ba 'di grub pa'o// shu bhaṃ//

// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ phyi nang gzhan gsum sbyor ba'i man ngag gi bstan bcos rin chen gter mdzod gsum pa zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo// chos kyi dbyings las ma gtogs pa'i// chos gzhan yod pa ma yin mod// phyi nang gzhan gsum zhes bya ba// bden pa gnyis las rab tu phye// las dang nyon mongs las byung ba'i// phyi nang kun rdzob bden pa ste// gzhan ni rang bzhin glo bur gyi// rnam dag don dam bden pa'o// thog mar phyi nang sbyar bshad nas// de dang gzhan sbyor tshul rjes 'chad// 'jig rten mu stegs la sogs pa// phyi yi dbang gis nang byung zhes// zer mod nang las phyi 'byung bar// theg chen pa rnams phal cher mthun// de yang kun gzhi'i steng du ni// 'khor ba'i phyogs kyi chos rnams kyi// sa bon bsags pa smin pa las// khams drug ldan pa'i skyes bu byung*// de yang mi nyid kyi dbang byas// mi lus 'dom gang gru bzhi pa'i// dpangs las 'jig rten 'bum phrag bzhi// sgal tshigs mgo bor snang ba yi// bag chags smin las ri rab kyang*// snang ngo mgo 'og tu tshud pa'i// don snod brten par bcas pa yi// bag chags dbang las ri mtsho gling*// drug tshan gsum po'ang sbas te snang*// lus la rtsa yi gtso mo gsum// gnas pas 'khor 'das gnyis byung zhing*// 'khor ba gzung dang 'dzin pa ste// ro rkyang gnyis su snang las byung*// gzung dang 'dzin pa gnyis spangs pa'i// dbu ma mya ngan 'das pa ste// kun gzhi'i ye shes zhes bya ba// chos kyi dbyings dang don gcig bzhed// ro rkyang dag tu rlung rgyu ba// phyi nang stong dang brgyad brgya re// phan tshun 'pho ba bcu gnyis po// drug tshan gnyis su phye byas nas// nang du 'pho chen bcu gnyis las// phyi ru sa dum bcu gnyis dang*// nam mkha' la yang khyim bcu gnyis// gzhan du bden don rnam bcu gnyis// gzung 'dzin rlung rnams phyis rgyus pas// gza' rnams shar du gdong bltas nas// g.yas min du rgyu khyim rnams la// rim pa bzhin du longs spyad pas// snod kyi 'jig rten ngo mtshar bar// byed do nyi ma'i bgrod pa gnyis// nang gi drug tshan gnyis las byung*// re re la yang khyim zla ni// drug drug nges par tshang yod par// 'pho chen re la las kyi rlung*// stong dang brgyad brgya nges par yang*// tshang dgos pa yi rgyu las byung*// nyi ma khyim du sdad pa yi// rgyu las dpyid dbyar ston dgun bzhi// byung nas snod rnams rgyas byed cing*// longs spyod tshogs rnams smin par byed// zla ba'i bgrod pa'ang nyi ma dang*// 'dra ste nang gi rgyu ba'i dbang*// yin mod zla bas tshes zla gcig

/nyi mas khyim lor 'khor dgos pa// zla bas de ltar 'khor ba ci// zhe na zla ba'i 'phel 'grib cha// rdzogs par myur zhing dus kyi cha// rdzogs pa bul te de yang ni// nang gi zla ba yar tshes la// 'dzin pa'i lam du 'phel gyur nas// spyi bor ham̐ la thim pa dang*// mar ngo la ni gzung ba yi// lam du zhugs nas 'gribs gyur pa// rdul la rdzogs par thim pa rnams// tshes zla gcig la byung phyir dang*// nang rdul cha shas bcu gnyis po// rdzogs la khyim zla bcu gnyis re// dgos so mngal gyi bcu dang ni// btsas pa'i gnyis dang bcas nas so// 'o na bu mo bcu gnyis mar// rdul mtha' rdzogs bshad ci zhe na// skabs der rdul gyis khu ba ni// 'dzin par nus pa'i dbang du byas// dper na skyes pa'i bcu drug lor// zla ba 'dor nus bshad de bzhin// nyi ma'i rang 'gros dus chen bzhir// byas phyir zla bas ci zhe na// dus re re la ra 'bring sogs// gsum po zla ba'i nya skar las// byung ngo tshes zla bcu gnyis po// rdzogs tshe nya skar bcu gnyis 'grig /nang du khu rdul mi ldan na// phyi ru nyi zla 'char mi 'gyur// sum mdo'i raṃ dang spyi bo'i haṃ// med na rta gdong 'bar ba dang*// byang du bsil ba'i ri mi snang*// nyi ma'i gdung byed bsil ri la// thug pas drod chen 'bar ba yang*// nang gi nyi zla'i 'phrod 'du las// yin te rta gdong 'bar ba'i 'od// nyi mar phog pas mtsho khol ba// sum mdo'i raṃ las lte ba'i me// sbar te mgrin par chu khol ba// phan tshun ltos pa'i rten 'brel lo// 'o na nang gi nyi ma ni// lus kyi smad na gnas pa'i phyir// phyi yi nyi ma ri rab kyi// thod dang mnyam par 'chad pa ci// zhe na thabs shes rnal 'byor las// lugs ldog dga' ba bzhi pa'i tshe// rdul yang spyi bo'i zla ba dang*// mnyam par rgyu ba'i rten 'brel las// yin no res 'ga' nyi ma ni// dpag tshad brgyad khri las mtho zhing*// res 'ga' bdun khri las kyang dma'// nang gi khu rdul gyen thur du// byed las phyi yi nyi zla yang*// de ltar byed cing chags chen dang*// chags bral nyid du byed pa'o// tshes lo re la nyi zla gnyis// kha sbyor byed pa bcu gnyis las// lhag pa mi 'byung nya skar yang*// bcu gnyis las lhag mi 'byung ngo*// gzhon nu ma la de 'dra'i lo// dang po dga' ba'i dga' nyid dus// nas brtsams bcu drug lo lon tshe// lhan cig skyes pa'i lhan skyes nyid// mngon du byed pa'i dus yin no// de bzhin gzhan la'ang bcu gnyis lor// rdul gyi zla ba 'dzin nus pa// byung tshe bden don bcu gnyis po// mngon du byed pa nus yin no// las rlung nang du 'jug pa yi// byed pas khyim rnams g.yas su rgyu// nyi zla'i rang 'gros shar dang ni// lho nas byang dang byang nas lho// steng nas 'og tu 'gro byed mod// khyim 'gros kho nas nub tu rgyu// de yi byed pas nyin mtshan du// snang phyir skyes bu'i lus stobs dang*// tshe dang bsod nams 'phel 'grib tu// byed pas rten 'brel sna tshogs 'byung*// rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa bdun gyis// ri rab 'khor thengs sum brgya dang*// drug bcu re lnga tshang ba na// khyim lo gcig tu 'jog pa yin// rgyu skar 'char dus de snyed la// nyi ma'i 'char dus sum brgya dang*// drug bcu las lhag yod ma yin// zla 'char sum brgya nga bzhi'o// rtsis mkhan phal cher de ring gi

/nyi shar nas brtsams sang nyin gyi// nyi shar bar de nyin zhag gcig /yin pas khyim lo gcig tshang bar// nyin zhag sum brgya re lnga dgos// zer ba rdzun no nyin re bzhin// nyi skar 'char ba'i dus tshod las// nyi ma 'char ba je ring du// song ba mngon sum gyis grub pas// nyin zhag tshad de 'thad ma yin// smin drug shar nas 'char gyi bar// tshad can gcig tu nges pa ni// nyin zhag re re'i tshad yin te// nyi ma shar nas 'char ka'i bar// snga ma de las cung lhag pa// khyim zhag re re'i tshad du bya// tshes zhag lkog tu gyur mod kyang*// zla ba'i 'phel 'grib sum cu po// rdzogs tshe tshes zla gcig tu tshang*// mngon par yud tsam sum cu la// nyin zhag gcig tu bshad pa yang*// skar ma'i 'char tshul dbang btsan pa// yin te nyi ma la bshad na// yud tsam sum cu las lhag 'gyur// bcu gnyis khyim gyi 'gro tshul las// sa la dus chen rnam bzhi dang*// tshes zla bcu gnyis 'byung ba yang*// phan tshun ltos pa'i rten 'brel te// dus bzhi nyi ma'i rang 'gros dang*// nyin mtshan nyi ma'i khyim 'gros las// byung ngo nya skar bcu gnyis po// zla ba kho na'i rang 'gros kyis// byas so zla bas mtshan 'khyol ba// khyim 'gros dbang las byung ba yin// 'dzam gling dbus mar nag pa yis// mtshan 'khyol byed pa'i tshes bco lnga// 'dzam gling shar mar sa ga yis// mtshan skyel byed pa'i bcu bzhi dang*// 'dzam gling nub mar dbo yis ni// mtshan skyel byed pa'i bcu drug tu// song ba sogs la dgongs pa'i tshig /dri med 'od las gsungs pa yin// sa yi dum bu bcu gnyis por// kla klo'i chos 'byung gnas pa'i lo// stong dang brgyad brgya gsungs pa yang*// las rlung rgyu ba'i grangs las byung*// rigs ldan drag pos kla klo'i chos// bcom nas rang gi bstan pa'i tshad// gsungs pa mi 'gyur bde ba ni// stong dang brgyad brgya'i dbang las byung*// 'dir bshad yul snang ji snyed kun// dus kyi 'khor lo la sogs dang*// bla med sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa// kho na'i rnam par shes pa la// snang ba'i dbang du byas yin gyi// spyi mthun las grub phyi rol don// yin par mngon pa'i chos las gsungs// 'dir bshad rang sems kyis bsdus pa// yin phyir 'dir 'byung mngon pa dang*// mi mthun rtsod pa'i go skabs bral// de nas gzhan gyi rnam gzhag ni// cung zad rgyas par bshad bya ba// gzhi dus rang bzhin gyis grub dang*// lam dus sbyangs pa las byung ngo*// dang po khams drug ldan pa yi// dbu ma rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i// dbang las sgra gcan lus dang ni// mgo dang 'jug tu snang ba 'char// mgo bo byang sems chu'i rang bzhin// mjug ma dus me rdul gyi de// lus ni thog med gzung 'dzin dang*// bral ba nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid// sgra gcan rang bzhin mya ngan las// 'das phyir khyim du mi 'jug cing*// khyim 'gros bshad pa 'chad mi nus// nang du sgra gcan lus dbang gis// phyi ru nam mkha'i khams dang ni// srid gsum bral ba'i 'du shes 'byung*// dbu ma'i lam du nyon mongs can// 'jug pa yod ma yin mod kyi// kun gzhi'i ye shes rnam smin cha// lhan cig rten dang brten par gnas// kun gzhi'i ye shes las rlung gis// skyed par nus pa ma yin mod// bag chags rlung gis g.yos pa las// rnam par smin pa ngar 'dzin byung*// ngar 'dzin pa dang las kyi rlung*// bdag po'i rkyen du gyur pa las// don dang sems can rnam rig tu// snang bas rnam par shes pa skye// ye shes ma gtogs rnam rig ni// thams cad 'khrul pa'i snang ba ste// las rlung rgyu ba kun khegs pas// snod bcud ma lus chos dbyings su// ro gcig gyur pa gang de nyid// rim pa gnyis po sgrub pa'i gzhi// gnyis pa sbyangs pa las gyur ni// nang gi dbang las phyi byung ba// sbyong byed skyed pa'i rim pa ste// nang nyid sbyong ba rdzogs rim mo// thog mar stong pa nyid bsams nas// phyi nang gzung 'dzin kun bral ba'i// rten dang brten par bcas pa yi// dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs gsal gdab pa// gsal snang de la rtog pa dang*// rtog med gsal ba mthar phyin gnyis// gnyis po zung du 'brel ba yis// bsod nams tshogs rdzogs byed pa dang*// zung du ma 'brel so so bas// sbyang gzhi sbyong bar nus ma yin// rtog pa'i skyed rim sngon song nas// sor bsdud dus su dkyil 'khor gyi// 'khor lo yongs su rdzogs gsal ba// de ni skyed pa'i rim pa yi// mchog yin zer na bsam gtan gyi// yan lag rnams dang ma bral bar// rgyun du goms par byas yin gyi// lung bstan min dang man ngag pa'i// snang ba de de ma yin mod// sbyang gzhi sbyong bar mi nus phyir// rgyun du bsgom par bya ba min// 'on kyang der snang de gzhan gyis// stong par shes las gang zag dang*// chos su 'dzin pa'i phyogs gcig sel// lugs 'dir rdzogs rim gyi gtso bo// 'gyur med bde ba chen po dang*// spang bya'i gtso bo 'pho ba yi// bag chags nyid la gang bshad pa// khams drug ldan pa'i skyes bu'i lus// tshe 'dir zag pa zad byed pa'i// thabs yin bdag 'dzin gnyis po yi// gnyen po logs su bsam par bya// 'bras dus gzhan zhes bya ba ni// bcu gnyis sa yi dbang phyug ste// 'pho chen ma lus 'gags pa'i phyir// ma dag snang ba mi 'char mod// dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs la sogs pa// gzugs med gzugs bzang dam pa ste// sna tshogs gzugs rnams 'chang ba'i dpal// gzugs brnyan ma lus 'chang ba po// dag pa'i snang ba 'ba' zhig pa// 'di ni sangs rgyas rang snang gi

/longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yin te// gzhan snang gzugs kyi sku gang nyid// gzhan sems de nyid kyis bsdus so// sngon goms dbang gis chos 'di la// mi phyed dad dang rnam dpyod rtsal// mchog ldan legs pa'i blo can gyis// rang lo don bdun pa la sbyar// // ༄༅// go la'i rnam bzhag nor bu'i them skas/ ༈ /na ma/ shrī ka la tsakra ye/ dus gsum mkha' la thogs pa med rgyu zhing*// dus min 'khyog po'i lam las grol gyur pas// dus me'i mdangs kyis nam yang mi 'khyud par// dus dgra'i bcom ldan nyi ma de dang 'dir rgyal// rnam mang phyi nang chos kyi lang tsho la// rnam dpyod drang po'i mig gis bltas pa na// rnam dag nges don ri mo ci yang 'char// rnam gsal go la'i lugs gnyis 'dir bshad bya// de yang 'di ltar go la'i rnam par bzhag pa rgyud 'grel gyi sgra ji bzhin pa de nyid sor bzhag na/ zlog par mi nus pa'i nyes pa gsum ste/ nyi ma khyim la gnas tshul dang mi mthun/ nyi ma 'char nub kyis dus dang 'gal ba/ zla ba'i nya skar dang mi 'grig pa rnams so// de la snga rgol gyis tsher ma 'byin pa na/ 'di skad ces/ nyes pa gsum pa ni/ 'gyur gyis 'khrul gzhi byas pa yin pas don la mi 'jug nyes pa gnyis pa ni/ theg pa thun mong gi dka' ba'i gnas yin pas 'dir spangs mi dgos/ nyes pa dang po mi 'jug pa'i tshul/ lho 'dzam bu gling gi lho bgrod mthar thug pa'i khyim gyi skar ma de byang sgra mi snyan gyi byang bgrod mthar thug gi khyim gyi skar ma yin par khas len pa yin no// zhes gsung*/ de lta na yang mngon sum dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa gnyis/ lung dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa gnyis/ rigs pa dang 'gal ba gnyis te drug gdon mi za bar 'jug par 'gyur ro// dang po ni/ 'o na lho gling dbus ma'i lho skar mthar thug gi mtshan gzhi skar ma chu stod de nub gling dbus ma'i ston nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i dus kyi nyi khyim gyi skar ma yin pa dang*/

shar gling dbus ma'i dpyid nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i dus kyi nyi khyim gyi skar ma yin par khas len dgos la/ de yang de lta na lho gling dbus ma'i byang bgrod mthar thug gi nyi khyim gyi skar ma'i mtshan gzhi skar ma lag de/ nub gling dbus ma'i dpyid nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i dus kyi nyi khyim gyi skar ma yin pa dang*/ shar gling dbus ma'i ston nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i dus kyi nyi khyim gyi skar ma yin par khas len dgos la/ de yang de las 'os med pas/ 'o na lho gling dbus ma 'dir/ bgrod gnyis mthar thug gi dus kyi khyim gyi skar ma chu stod 'char sa dang*/ lag 'char sa gnyis gcig par thal ba dang*/ nub sa gcig par thal ba dang*/ shar gling dbus ma dang*/ nub gling dbus mar ston dpyid nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i dus kyi nyi khyim gyi skar ma chu stod dang lag gnyis po der 'char phyed nub gsum gyi sa tshod gcig pa'i phyir/ rtags khas blangs te/ de dus kyi skar ma de gnyis shar nub kyi gling de gnyis kyi nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i dus gnyis kyi nyi khyim gyi skar ma yin pa'i phyir/ de'i khyab pa de pa'i steng du mngon sum gyis grub ste/ lho gling dbus ma 'dir ston dpyid nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i dus kyi nyi khyim gyi skar ma nag pa dang*/ tha skar gnyis shar phyed nub gsum gyi sa tshod gcig pa bzhin/ de ltar na rtags khas blangs/ khyab pa mngon sum gyis grub/ thal chos la mngon sum yi bsal ba zhugs pa 'di ni lan gyis zlog par mi nus pa'i thal 'gyur dang po'o// de yang de ltar grub pa de'i tshe nyi ma gang la gnas pa'i khyim gyi skar ma tha skar dang*/ nag pa gnyis po shar nub kyi gling dbus ma gnyis kyi bgrod pa gnyis mthar thug pa'i dus kyi nyi khyim gyi skar mar khas len dgos la/ de lta na skar ma nag pa chos can/ nub gling dbus ma'i lho bgrod mthar thug pa'i sa nas 'char ba thal/ gling de'i dgun nyi zlog pa'i dus kyi nyi khyim gyi skar ma yin pa'i phyir/

rtags khas blangs/ khyab pa dpe'i steng du mngon sum gyis grub ste/ lho gling dbus ma bzhin no// 'dod na/ skar ma tha skar chos can/ nub gling dbus ma'i byang bgrod mthar thug nas shar bar thal/ de'i dbyar nyi log dus kyi khyim skar yin pa'i phyir/ de yang 'dod na/ dus de gnyis kyi skar ma de gnyis chos can/ nub gling dbus mar 'char sa 'gal ba can gnyis nas 'char ba ma yin te/ lho gling dbus ma'i nam mkha' la gnas sa gcig kho na yin pa'i phyir/ yang nag pa chos can/ lho gling dbus ma'i nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i dus der lho gling dbus ma'i byang bgrod mthar thug pa'i nam mkha' la gnas par thal/ khyod dus der nub gling dbus ma'i lho bgrod mthar thug nas shar ba'i phyir/ yang tha skar chos can/ lho gling dbus ma'i ston nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i dus der/ gling de'i lho bgrod mthar thug gi nam mkha' la gnas par thal/ dus der nub gling dbus ma'i byang bgrod mthar thug nas shar ba'i phyir/ de ltar na rtags khyab gnyis ka khas blangs/ thal chos la mngon sum gyi bsal ba zhugs pas zlog par mi nus pa'i thal 'gyur gnyis pa yin no// de lta bu'i thal 'gyur gnyis kyis mngon sum dang 'gal ba bstan zin nas/ gnyis pa lung dang 'gal ba gnyis ni 'di ltar/ lho gling dbus ma'i lho skar mthar thug gang yin pa de/ byang gling dbus ma'i byang skar mthar thug tu khas len/ nag pa'i phyed nas nam gru'i bar gyi khyim drug po de me'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa dang*/ tha skar nas nag pa'i phyed kyi bar khyim drug po de/ byang du bsil ba'i ri la gnas par gsungs pa dang 'gal lo// ji ltar zhe na/ ji skad du/ tha skar la sogs nag po'i ched du nyin dang mtshan mo mnyam pa'i dbus su go la'i ri mo'o// rgyu skar g.yas dang g.yas min dag la nges par srid pa'i gnas su khyim gyi dbye bas yang dag gnas/ zhes dang*/ gzhu'i rnam pa'i dus khyim dag la go la'i dbus nas lhor ni me'i dkyil 'khor la gnas shing*// byang du de ni bsil ba'i ri ste pad 'dab bzang po bzhin du shar du lug dang srang la sogs pa la'o zhes gsungs pas so// yang*/

lho gling dbus ma'i lho bgrod mthar thug pa'i tshe/ byang gling dbus mar byang bgrod mthar thug tu khas len na/ nyi ma g.yas phyogs su bgrod pa 'di rang 'gros dang khyim 'gros gang rung ma yin pa'i gzhan zhig du khas len dgos la/ de lta na ni khyim 'gros kho nar bshad pa dang 'gal lo// ji ltar zhe na/ ji skad du/ de'i phyir 'khor ba'i shugs 'di ni khyim gyi yin gyi/ khyim gyi gzhi la gnas pa'i nyi mas ni ma yin no// 'dir khyim gyi 'khor lo ni g.yas skor gyis 'khor te/ gza' rnams ni khyim dag la g.yas min gyi rgyu'o// zhes gsungs pas so// ci ste rlung 'gros su khas len no snyam na/ de skad de ni/ chos mngon pa 'chad pa po rnams kyi tshig gi rten tsam yin gyi/ chos 'di la de'i bshad pa med do// de ltar lung dang 'gal ba gnyis bstan zin nas/ gsum pa rigs pa dang 'gal ba gnyis ni/ lho gling dbus ma'i lho drang thad kyi rta gdong gi me de/ byang gling dbus ma'i byang shar gyi phyogs na yod par 'gyur ba dang*/ lho gling dbus ma'i byang drang thad kyi bsil ba'i ri de/ byang gling dbus ma'i shar lho'i thad na yod par 'gyur te/ de dang der nyi ma nub sa na de dang der shar ba'i phyir/ de yang 'dod na/ ri rab byang sgra mi snyan gyi lho phyogs na yod par 'gyur ro// yang tha skar nas nag pa'i bar gyi khyim drug po der shar gling dbus ma dang*/ nub gling dbus ma gnyis su res 'ga' lhor gnas shing res 'ga' nub tu gnas par thal/ lho gling dbus ma 'dir dpyid nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i tshe/ shar gling dbus mar byang bgrod mthar thug nub gling dbus mar lho bgrod mthar thug yang gling 'dir ston gyi nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i tshe/ shar du lho bgrod mthar thug nub tu byang bgrod mthar thug pa'i phyir/ de ltar lugs snga ma sun 'byin pa'i tshul brjod zin nas/ gnyis pa lugs phyi ma 'thad pa'i phyogs su bzhag pa la gnyis te/

khyim gyi go la nam mkha' la 'char ba'i tshul dang*/ khyim der nyi ma bgrod pa ni sa'i go la gling dum bu bcu gnyis su 'byung ba'i tshul lo// dang po ni/ lug la sogs pa'i khyim bcu gnyis po de dus thams cad du 'char nub kyi sa tshod nges pa can kho na yin te/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa bdun po thams cad rang rang gi 'char nub kyi nges pa can re re kho nar dus rtags tu mngon sum gyis grub pa'i phyir/ de yang tha skar nas nag po'i phyed kyi bar khyim drug ni/ dbyibs pad+ma bzang po'i rnam pa can/ phyogs ni thams cad du byang gi cha kho nar gnas/ dpangs tshad ni sa steng nas dpag tshad brgyad khri drug stong 'phags pa'o// nag pa nas nam gru'i bar khyim drug ni/ dbyibs ni gzhu bdungs pa'i rnam pa can/ phyogs ni thams cad du lho'i cha/ dpangs tshad ni chu'i steng nas dpag tshad bdun khri lnga stong 'phags pa'o// de lta bu'i rgyu skar gyi phreng ba de ri rab la 'khor ba'i tshul yang*/ skyes bu'i mgrin par nor bu'i do shar ring po brgyus pas phyogs thams cad du bskor ba bzhin du yon por 'khor ba yin gyi/ mgo thog gdugs phub pa ltar zlum po kho nar 'khor ba ni min te/ der mi 'khor bar mngon sum gyis grub bo// khyim bcu gnyis ni zlum por 'khor ba yin te/ rgyu skar rang rang so so'i thob thang gi rgya khyon gyi tshad la khyim du 'jog pa'i phyir/ dper na 'og tu chu'i dkyil 'khor ji ltar gnas pa'i tshul nam mkha' la khyim gyi 'khor lo 'khor zhing rgyu ba'i phyir ro// gnyis pa la/ nyi ma khyim la gnas pa'i tshul/ sa la dus kyi go la 'byung ba'i tshul lo// dang po la/ nyi ma la 'gros gnyis te/ khyim 'gros kyi dbang gis g.yas phyogs kho nar 'gro ba dang*/ rang 'gros kyi dbang gis phyogs gzhan du 'gro ba'o// de la'ang gsum ste/ dus rtag tu shar phyogs su dal bar 'gro ba dang*/ res g.yas g.yon du 'khyog por 'gro ba'o// de la'ang gnyis te/

g.yas phyogs su rta gdong gi me mtshams su 'gro ba dang*/ g.yon phyogs bsil ba'i ri la thug par 'gro ba'o// gnyis pa ni/ gling dum bu bcu gnyis su dus bzhi mnyam du 'du ba yin te/ nyi ma me'i dkyil 'khor la thug pa'i dus dang*/ bsil ba'i ri la thug pa'i dus kyi nyin zhag re re yod pa de gling thams cad du dus gcig la 'byung ba'i phyir/ ji ltar zhe na/ lho gling dbus ma 'dir dpyid kyi nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i tshe/ srang gi khyim nub pa dang*/ lug khyim shar ba dus gcig yang lug khyim nub pa dang srang khyim shar ba dus gcig byang gling dbus mar yang dus de'i tshe/ dpyid kyi nyin mtshan mnyam zhing*/ khyim gyi 'char nub de kho na'o// gling de gnyis su ston nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i tshe yang khyim gyi 'char nub snga ma de bzhin kho nar nges so// gling de gnyis su ston dpyid kyi nyin mtshan mnyam pa de'i tshe/ lho gling dbus ma nas g.yas skor bgrangs pa'i dum bu gnyis pa dang*/ brgyad pa la ston dpyid kyi nyin mtshan mnyam pa de'i tshe/ glang khyim dang sdig khyim 'char nub kyi dus kyi dus ni de'i nyin mtshan gyi dus gnyis so// yang 'khrig pa dang*/ gzhu'i khyim gnyis kyi 'char dus gnyis ni/ dum bu gsum pa dang dgu pa'i ston dpyid kyi nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i dus gnyis kyi nyin mtshan gyi dus so// de bzhin du gzhan la yang sbyor/ de ltar nyi ma skar ma tha skar gyi khyim du gnas shing*/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nag pas nya gang ba de'i tshe gling 'dir dpyid kyi nyin mtshan mnyam zhing*/ sa'i dum bu gzhan thams cad du yang khyim de kho na dang*/ zla ba de kho na dang*/ dus de kho nar nges pa yin te/ de las gzhan du 'grel pa'i sgra ji bzhin par brtag na/ gling 'dir lug gi khyim du dpyid kyi nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i tshe/ byang gling dbus mar srang gi khyim du ston gyi nyin mtshan mnyam par 'dod dgos pa las/

de ltar 'byung ba'i go skabs med pa'i phyir dang*/ yang ji skad du/ de phyir gnyis brgyad dum bu dag /nges par glang la gnas pa dang*// sdig pa la gnas de bzhin no// zhes gsungs pa'ang sgra ji bzhin par khas len dgos na/ de 'dra 'byung ba'i go skabs med pa'i phyir/ gal te yod na nyi mas nyin mtshan phrugs gcig la khyim bcu gnyis pa thams cad 'khor bar thal ba'i phyir ro// des nye bar mtshon nas nyi ma srang gi khyim la gnas shing zla ba'i dkyil 'khor tha skar gyi nya gang ba de'i tshe gling 'dir ston gyi nyin mtshan mnyam pa 'byung zhing*/ gling gzhan thams cad du yang de kho nar nges pa dang*/ nyi ma gzhu'i khyim du gnas shing zla ba rgyal gyis nya ba'i tshe gling thams cad du dgun nyi log pa dang*/ nyi ma 'khrig pa'i khyim du gnas shing zla ba snron dus der gling thams cad du dbyar nyi log par khas len dgos pa yin no// de'i phyir gling thams cad du bgrod pa gnyis mthar thug pa dang*/ nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i dus gnyis te/ bzhi ka la nyin zhag tshang ma re re dgos par nges so// 'o na ji skad du/ khyim gcig la ni nyi ma gnas pas mtha' dag dus kyi tshogs dang zla ba dang ni phyogs rnams byed// ces bshad pa dang 'gal lo snyam na ma yin te/ de ni sa'i go la'i dbang du byas nas gsungs pa'i phyir/ de yang ji ltar zhe na/ khyim gang yang rung ba gcig la nyi ma gnas pa de'i tshe/ khyim bcu gnyis dang sa dum bu bcu gnyis phan tshun drang thad du gnas shing*/ rang rang gi thob thang gi khyim du 'jug pa'i phyir/ dper na lho gling dbus ma 'dir nyi ma lug khyim du gnas bzhin pa shar nas chu tshod lnga'i yun 'dzam gling dbus ma lug khyim gyi thob thang yin pas na/ lho gling shar ma glang khyim gyi thob thang yin pa la sogs pa bzhin no// nyi mas rang rang gi khyim der sleb pa'i tshe dpyid zla tha chung dang*/ dbyar zla rwa ba la sogs par 'gyur ba dgongs nas/

mtha' dag dus kyi tshogs rnams byed ces gsungs pa yin no// yang gling zla ba nag pas nya gang ba de'i tshe/ nya skar bcu gnyis po re re dang*/ sa dum bu bcu gnyis po re re nas drang thad du gnas shing*/ sa de dang de'i dbang res kyis nya skar du 'jog pa yin la/ zla ba'i rang 'gros kyis sa ga dang*/ lhan cig tu nya gang ba la sogs pa'i tshe/ dpyid zla tha chung dbyar zla rwa ba la sogs par 'jog pa yin no// de skad du yang*/ dum bu dum bu dag tu zla bar gyur te sa bzhi bcu gnyis rtsibs rnams la ni rim pas so zhes dang*/ 'grel par lho'i dum bu 'dir lug la nyi ma gnas pas dpyid kyi zla ba byed do// me zur gyi dum bu gnyis snron gyi zla ba byed do// zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs so// de ltar bshad pas grub pa'i don ni/ nyi khyim gyi dbang du byas na lug khyim dang*/ nya skar gyi dbang du byas na sa ga 'dzam bu gling dbus ma'i thob thang yin pa sogs gzhan rnams la yang de ltar sbyar ba de la ni sa'i go la zhes bya ba'i rnam par bzhag pa 'di grub pa yin no// 'o na nyi mas gling thams cad kyi lho bgrod mthar thug pa'i tshe nyi ma thung ba dang*/ thams cad kyi byang bgrod mthar thug pa'i tshe nyi ma ring bar 'jog mi rigs te/ de las zlog nas khas len par rigs pa'i phyir/ dper na mchod rten la bskor ba bzhin no zhe na/ nyes pa med de/ dus de gnyis kyi nyi ma'i rgyu lam la ring thung gi khyad par yod kyang*/ rgyu dus la ring thung gi khyad par med de/ dper na gdugs dang chu skor gyi lte ba dang mu khyud bzhin no// de'i phyir bgrod gnyis mthar thug gi dus kyi nyin zhag gnyis po la chu tshod mang nyung gi khyad zhugs par thal ba'i skyon med do// 'o na byang bgrod mthar thug gi dus kyi nyi ma'i rgyu lam thag ring ba dang*/ gcig shos thung bar mngon sum gyis grub pa ci zhe na/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni/

gling 'dir byang bgrod mthar thug pa'i tshe gling 'di'i nyi ma 'char sa ni/ byang sgra mi snyan gyi nyi ma nub pa'i dus kyi steng gi nam mkha' de nas shar/ 'di'i nyi ma nub pa'i sa ni byang gling dbus mar shar nas cung zad cig lon pa'i dus kyi nyi ma'i gnas sa der nub pa dang*/ yang gling 'dir lho bgrod mthar thug pa'i tshe gling 'di'i nyi ma 'char sa de shar gling dbus ma'i nyi ma phyed yol nas 'char/ nub sa ni nub gling dbus ma'i nyi ma phyed pa der nub pa yin pa la thug go /mdor na nyi ma byang shar gyi mtshams nas shar na nub byang gi mtshams su nub pa dang*/ yang nyi ma shar lho'i mtshams nas lho nub kyi mtshams su nub pa'i dus kyi nyi ma'i rgyu lam la ring thung gi khyad par 'byung ba 'os med kyi rigs pa yin no// mdor na byang bgrod mthar thug gi dus su nyi ma gling gsum dang*/ sa dum bu dgu khyab pa'i dus srid/ lho bgrod mthar thug pa'i tshe nyi mas ging gcig kho na dang*/ sa dum bu gsum las ma khyab pa'i dus cig srid/ nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i tshe gling gnyis dang*/ sa dum bu drug kho na la nyi mas nges par khyab pa yin no// rgyud kyi dgongs pa rgyud 'grel gyis bkral ba// sngon gyi mkhas pas sngon nas legs dpyad kyang*// mngon sum nyid dang mngon par 'gal mthong nas// rang lugs 'jog tshul rang gi rigs pas sbyar// rnam bkra shel gyi ri mo ngo mtshar can// rnam gsal thugs mtsho'i me long la 'phos nas// rnam dpyod gzu bo'i gsung gis 'doms mkhas pa// rnam rgyal grags pa'i drung du mchid 'di phul// gang dang mnyam pa'i khams pa ma mchis pas// gang gi mkhyen pa'i rgya khyon mi dpogs kyang*// gang la 'chams pa'i legs bshad thob bya'i phyir// gang gsung de la dpyad nas lugs gzhan bsnyad// lugs 'dir lung dang rigs pas gnod gyur na// lugs ngan 'di la phangs pa ci zhig 'tshal// lugs brgya ldan pa'i rigs pas 'di grub na// lugs gzhan snga ma dor dgos ma lags sam// yid 'bab rna bar snyan zhing lung dang mthun// yid la gcags pa'i rigs pa brgyas bskrun pa'i// yid 'ong go la'i rnam gzhag 'di bris pas// yid kyi ltad mo ci yang 'char byed shog

/gzhan la 'gran dang rang gi rnyed grags dang*// gzhan gzhung 'jig pa'i phyir du 'di ma sbyar// gzhan dag chos kyi gtam la bskul bya'i phyir// gzhan phan blo yis bris 'di skyon ma yin// lung dang rigs pa'i mig gnyis rab bgrad cing*// rnam dpyod lag pa mkha' la rab bteg nas// shes bya'i gangs la thogs med 'phyo ba yi// dpal ldan smra ba'i seng ger bdag gyur cig /ka lā pa yi grong khyer ni// kha ba'i chu shel dkar po'i khri// ga pur dri mdangs kyis spud der// nga rgyal 'khor lo'i mgon po ni// shākya'i rigs kyi thig le mchog /dpal ldan zla ba bzang po yi// zhabs sen yid 'ong khyod gtsug tu// rab 'chang legs pa'i blo yis sbyar// de yi legs byas mdangs kyis ni// sa skyong mched dang bcas pa yi// bzhed pa'i don kun gegs med par// bde blag nyid du 'char byed shog /ces go la'i rnam par bzhag pa rgyud 'grel gyi pho brang du 'jug pa nor bu'i 'od kyi them skas zhes bya ba mnga' ris smad kyi sa'i thig ler grub pa'o// shu bhaṃ// // ༄༅// rgyu skar gyi dge mtshan brtag pa'i rab byed// ༄༅// smra ba rnams kyi mchog thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhabs kyi rdul rnyog pa med pa la tshangs pa'i cod paṇa gyis gtugs nas yid rab tu dwang bas phyag 'tshal lo// 'phrog byed ral pa'i chu gter nyams dga' bar// zhabs zung ngang pa'i ded dpon gar mdzad cing*// zhabs rten pad mo'i nags su lha brgya yis// gtsug rgyan chu shel dkar pos mdzes mtshon pa// yongs la phan dgongs snying nas brtse ba can// rang dang 'tshams pa'i gtsug lag brgya 'chad cing*// 'jig rten blang dor lan brgyar ston mdzad pa'i// kun gyis mes po khyod la mgos phyag 'tshal// thos pa'i bdud rtsi bsags pa'i chu gter du// rnam dpyod ku mud rgyas pa'i rtse dga' dang*// gzhan phan mgrin pa'i rdza rnga rdung byed pa'i// bshes gnyen de dag kun gyis mchod par 'os// de ltar mchod par brjod cing rtsom par dam bcas nas/

rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyis dge mtshan brtag pa/ mdo sde sna tshogs las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin/ rang bzo spangs te go bde ba'i ngag gis brjod par bya'o// smin drug snar ma mgo lag dang*// nab so rgyal dang skag dang 'chu// bre dbo me bzhi nag pa dang*// sa ri sa ga lha mtshams snron// snrubs chu stod smad gro zhun dang*// byi bzhin mon gru mon gre dang*// khrums stod khrums smad nam gru dang*// tha skar bra nye nyi shu brgyad// smin drug skar ma drug yin ste// dbyibs ni spu gri lta bu la// yud tsam sum cu'i cha dang ldan// kha zas zho yin lha ni me// rus ni rje'u rigs yin no// rgyu skar ma gcig /dbyibs ni thig le lta bu la// yud tsam sum cu rtsa lnga ldan// kha zas mar gyi nying khu ste// lha dang rus ni go rim bzhin// nyi ma rgyas pa zhes bya'o// rgyu skar nab so skar ma gnyis// dbyibs ni rkang pa lta bu la// yud tsam bco lnga'i cha dang ldan// kha zas sbrang rtsi lha phur bu// rus ni dbang byed ces bshad do// rgyu skar rgyal ni skar ma gsum// dbyibs ni ril ba lta bu la// yud tsam sum cu'i cha dang ldan// kha zas sbrang rtsi dang yos so// lha dang rus ni go rim bzhin// phur bu yid nye zhes bya'o// rgyu skar skag ni skar ma gcig /dbyibs ni thig le lta bu la// yud tsam bco lnga'i cha dang ldan// kha zas sbrang rtsi dang yos so// lha ni rlung lha rus ni sbrul// 'di bdun shar gyis sgor gtogs so// rgyu skar chu ni skar ma lnga// dbyibs ni chu bo'i 'gyur lta bu// yud tsam gsum cu'i cha dang ldan// kha zas til dang 'o ma'o// lha ni spen par rus ser skya// rgyu skar bre ni skar ma gnyis// dbyibs ni rkang pa lta bu la// yud tsam sum cu'i cha dang ldan// kha zas bil ba lha skal ldan// rus ni go'u ta ma'o// rgyu skar dbo ni skar ma gnyis// dbyibs ni gdan khri lta bu la// yud tsam bzhi bcu rtsa lngar ldan// kha zas sbal pa'i sha yin te// lha dang rus ni go rim bzhin// 'phags pa ko'u shi ka'o// rgyu skar me bzhi skar ma lnga// dbyibs ni lag pa lta bu la// yud tsam sum cu'i cha dang ldan// kha zas bya dang sre ta 'o// lha ni nyi ma rus sred ldan// rgyu skar nag pa skar ma gcig

/pad+ma'i snying po lta bu la// yud tsam sum cu'i cha dang ldan// kha zas sha thog sna tshogs za// lha dang rus ni nyi ma dang*// nag pa ya na zhes bya'o// rgyu skar sa ri skar ma gcig /dbyibs ni thig le lta bu la// yud tsam bco lnga'i cha dang ldan// kha zas mon sran rde'u sogs// lha ni rlung lha rus yid can// rgyu skar sa ga skar ma bzhi// ra'i rten mgo lta bu la// yud tsam bzhi bcu rtsa lngar kha zas sha chang lha phur bu// rus ni dmigs pa ya na 'o// rgyu skar snron ni skar ma bzhi// dbyibs ni theg skas lta bu la// yud tsam bco lnga'i cha dang ldan// kha zas 'bras dang nas dang gro// lha dang rus ni dbang po dang*// ring pa'i rgyud ces bya bar bshad// rgyu skar snubs ni skar ma dgu// dbyibs ni sdig pa lta bu la// yud tsam sum cu'i cha dang ldan// kha zas rtsa ba dang 'bras bu// lha dang rus ni dmangs rigs dang*// ka ta ya na'i rgyud yin no// rgyu skar chu stong skar ma bzhi// ba lang 'jug ma sgreng lta bu// yud tsam sum cu'i cha dang ldan// kha zas bya gro ta yid chu// lha dang rus ni chu lha dang*// dur ba'i rgyud ces bya ba'o// rgyu skar chu smad skar ma bzhi// dbyibs ni glang chen 'phyong lta bu// yud tsam bzhi bcu rtsa lngar ldan// kha zas sbrang rtsi 'bras yos te// lha dang rus ni rgyas pa dang*// me 'gal ya na zhes bya'o// rgyu skar byi bzhin skar ma gsum// dbyibs ni ba lang mgo lta bu// yud tsam drug gi cha dang ldan// kha zas rlung yin lha tshangs pa// rus ni tshangs pa dang ldan no// rgyu skar gro zhun skar ma gsum// dbyibs ni lag rnga lta bu la// yud tsam sum cu'i cha dang ldan// kha zas bya'i sha yin te// lha dang rus ni khyab 'jug dang*// ka ta ya na gsum pa'o// bdun po nub kyi sgor gtogs so// rgyu skar mon gre skar ma bzhi// dbyibs ni 'dab chags bya lta bu// yud tsam sum cu'i cha dang ldan// kha zas rgya sran dang ni chu// lha dang rus ni nor lha /dbyibs ni thig le lta bu la// yud tsam bco lnga'i cha dang ldan// kha zas nas dang gro yin te// lha dang rus ni chu lha dang*// dan da ya na zhes bya'o// rgyu skar khrums stod skar ma gnyis// dbyibs ni rta so 'dra ba la// yud tsam sum cu'i cha dang ldan// kha zas lug gi khrag yin te// lha ni klu dang bza' lag yin// rus ni bram ze sna can no// rgyu skar khrums smad skar ma gnyis// dbyibs ni rkang pa lta bu la// yud tsam bzhi bcu rtsa lngar ldan// kha zas bal sran lha 'phags pa// rus ni nor rgyal gyi brgyud do// rgyu skar nam gru skar ma gcig /dbyibs ni thig le lta bu la// yud tsam sum cu'i cha dang ldan// kha zas zho yin lha rgyal po// rus ni srin mo rgyal gyis rgyu// tha skar skar ma gnyis yin te// dbyibs ni rta mchog 'gros lta bu// yud tsam sum cu'i cha dang ldan// kha zas sbrang rtsi'i thug pa'o// lha dang rus ni dri za dang*// rba 'jigs nas gyi rgyud yin no// bra nye skar ma gsum yin te// dbyibs ni chos 'byung lta bu la// yud tsam sum cu'i cha dang ldan// kha zas til dang 'bras yin te// lha dang rus ni shin rje dang*// rga'i rgyud ces bya ba'o// rgyu skar 'di bdun byang rgor bzhag /mdor na snar ma nab so gre// sa ga chu smad khrums smad dang*// drug po yud tsam bzhi bcu lnga// lag dang skag dang sa ri snron// sa ga dang lnga bcu lnga'i cha// byi bzhin yud tsam drug yin te// gzhan rnams yud tsam sum cu'o// bdun ni mnyam dang lhan pas ta// shar gyi bzhi dang sa ga dang*// lha 'tshams dang ni sa ri'o// drag po gsum yin lag dang skag /bra nye'i mchod gnas bzhi po ni// byang gi gsum dang snar ma'o// 'jam po lnga ste gro bzhin dang*// nam gru mon gre snron dang snubs// 'dzin pa'i rigs lnga me bzhi dang*// nag pa skag dang mchu byi bzhin// myur bar byed bzhi smin drug dang*// mgo dang rgyal dang tha skar ro// rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad po// 'jug pa gsum dang ldan pa ste// khyu mchog ba bu'i 'jug pa dang*// lhan cig zung du 'jug pa'o// zla ba rgyu skar gang de yid// phyis nas 'gro ba khyu mchog gis// 'jug pa zhes bya de zlog pa// ba be'u'i 'jug pa yin zhes bya// mnyam du 'gro ba lhan cig pa// rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa'o// gnas ni 'di yin smin drug ni// ma ka ta dang ka ling ka

/snar ma skyed dgu thams cad la// lus 'phags po dang rgyal po yi// zham ring mgo yi gnas yin no// lag dang nab so brgyal dang skag /klu dang gangs can la gnas so// klu ni shar phyogs mi rnams la// gre ni rkun ma rnams la ste// dbo ni sa bon rigs rnams la// me bzhi yul 'khor ba rnams la// nag pa bya dang rkang gnyis par// sa ri rab byung thams cad la// sa ga chu la gnas pa yi// srog chags rnams la rtag tu gnas// lha 'tshams tshong pa zong ldan pa// snron ni sgo bsrung rnams la gnas// snubs ni mgron po rnams la'o// chu stod 'ba' dhin ka pa la// chu smad skam po tshe'i gling*// gro zhun rkun ma dang pho nya// byi zhun lho phyogs pa kun dang*// zang gling ba rnams la gnas so// mon gru ko ko shi ka dang*// srid srung ba rnams la gnas so// mon gre ko ru lnga can la// khrums stod gan ta ra pa dang*// phur bu mig dmar sgra gcan dang*// 'jug ring nyi ma zla ba ste// 'dir ni gza' rnams dgur bshad do// de nas lung bsten bshad bya ba// smin drug la skyes grags par ldan// snar ma la skyes skal ba bzang*// mgo la 'thab mo don gnyer 'gyur// lag la skyes pa zas skom rnyed// nab so zhing rmo ba lang skyong*// rgyal la tshul khrims ldan par 'gyur// skag la skyes pa chags pa che// mchu la mthu rtsal che bar 'gyur// gre la skyes pa tshe thung ste// dbo la skyes pa tshul khrims ldan// me bzhi la skyes rkun mar 'gyur// nag pa klu dang gar la mkhas// sa ri rtsis mkhas dpon du 'gyur// sa ga rgyal po'i mngag zhugs par// lha mtshams tshong pa zong ldan du// snron la longs spyod chung par 'gyur// snubs la grags ldan bu dang bcas// chu stod la skyes rnal 'byor par// chu smad rigs btsun dbang phyug che// bye bzhin grags dang ldan par 'gyur// gro zhun la skyes rgyal pos mchod// mon gre la skyes rig pa chung*// mon gru la skyes phreng rgyud mkhan// khrums stod chom kun ded dpon 'gyur// khrums smad la skyes dri zhim pa// nam gru la skyes gru par 'gyur// tha skar la skyes rta tshong pa// bra nye gzhan la brten pas 'tsho// gzhan yang yon tan bshad bya ba// smin drug la skyes mi pho ni// dka' thub ldan zhing brku la dga'// dpa' zhing gtum la gzhung lugs shes// snar ma la skyes nor dang ldan// chos la dga' zhing brtson 'grus brtan// dpa' la bde dang ldan par 'gyur// mgo la 'jam mdzes lta bar 'os// khyad par bud med dga' bar 'gyur// lag la khro gtum pha rol 'jig

/drag po la sbyor khang bzang rnyed// nab so 'dod chung blo dang ldan// tshul khrims dang bcas spro thung ba// rgyal la gzi brjid che ldan zhing*// mang pos mchod pa'i 'os su 'gyur// skag la skyes pa spro thung zhing*// skyes bu ngan pa'i dpon du'ang 'gyur// mchu la shes rab che ldan zhing*// lag gtsang bsod nams chen por 'gyur// gre la chos min blo ldan zhing*// rtag tu bla ma smod par byed// dbo la longs spyod che ldan zhing*// mngon shes thob pa'i skal ldan 'gyur// me bzhi pha rol zil gnon zhing*// bdag nyid gzhan gyi gnon mi nus// nag pa la skyes gtam la mkhas// kun gyis yid 'ong tshul khrims ldan// sa ri mnyan mangs mkhas la 'jam// sa gas brjid ldan nor mang la// gtong la dga' zhing pha rol gnon// lha mtshams grogs mang khyim dang bcas// rang bzhin bzang zhing byas pa bzo// snron
